relations.subject: Kaetan Andreevič Kossovič
relations.evidence: In 1836-39 studied classical philology and philosophy (Plato) at Moscow University

relations.subject: Kaetan Andreevič Kossovič
relations.evidence: In 1839-43 taught Greek at Tambov Gymnasium in Tver

relations.subject: Kaetan Andreevič Kossovič
relations.evidence: In 1850 moved to St.Petersburg and worked as editor in the Imperial Public Library

relations.subject: Kaetan Andreevič Kossovič
relations.evidence: From 1858 taught Sanskrit, from 1860 as the first (eo.) Professor of Sanskrit at Oriental Faculty of St.Petersburg University, from 1866 ord. Professor.

relations.subject: Kaetan Andreevič Kossovič
relations.evidence: In the St.Petersburg scholarly circles he belonged to the Russian party and polemized with Böhtlingk and Schiefner.
